recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The remaining return documentation should stay on the later FHIR-51487 wording because it already points to the FHIR-50487 Bundles Organized by Subject section and preserves the intended multi-cardinality Parameters response guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-51066 was an Applied/Persuasive CQI R6 change request asking that Measure/$collect-data be aligned with the DEQM STU5 operation, including a one-or-more-measures introduction, return Bundle documentation with Bundles Organized by Subject guidance, and an example response containing a return out parameter whose resource is a Bundle.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#3932 and commit 5e118b71178ff07d248c84395bc0f36cf7919cd3 initially aligned the operation parameters and much of the return description. Later commit 9aafebcbaf1bf483be501112cc5fdca132848446 for FHIR-51487 added the Bundles Organized by Subject link and operations-framework Parameters note. The current source still retained single-measure introductory wording and an example response with loose measureReport/resource Parameters entries.
additional_context: Measure is active in source/fhir.ini, and OperationDefinition/Measure-collect-data includes $collect-data-response.txt, which includes collect-data-response.json. The Bundles Organized by Subject section requested through FHIR-50487 exists and is already linked from the return documentation. FHIR-55967 later changed reporter parameters in the same operation but did not affect the remaining FHIR-51066 gaps. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting decision record.
reconciliation: Updated the Measure/$collect-data description to say the operation collects data-of-interest for one or more measures for one or more subjects, and wrapped the response example resources in a collection Bundle returned as the single Parameters parameter named return.
source_changes: source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-collect-data.xml: changed the description's first sentence from the older single-measure wording to the resolved one-or-more-measures/subjects wording.

source/measure/collect-data-response.json: changed the included example response so Parameters.parameter[0].name is return and its resource is a collection Bundle containing the MeasureReport and data-of-interest resources.
